page: Microsoft Azure E20d_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor running at a base clock of 2.8 GHz. The instance allocates 20 dedicated virtual CPUs across 10 physical cores via hyperthreading, backed by 48 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates 160 GB of system memory, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. Local temporary storage is directly integrated into the instance, offering an 805 GB solid-state drive for scratchpad data and temporary file structures. It contains no hardware accelerators or dedicated graphics processing units.

Benchmark evaluation shows robust memory subsystem throughput, with the PassMark memory benchmark rating in the top 25 percent at 2,801.06 points. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 112.59 GB/s, while write bandwidth stabilizes at 59.76 GB/s. Standard compute results, including Geekbench multi-core (11,036 points) and PassMark CPU score (25,547.1 points), place the instance in the middle 50 percent of tested machines. Workloads involving in-memory key-value processing, such as Redis SET operations, achieve 19.81 million operations per second.

The hardware profile emphasizes memory density and local disk access over specialized compute acceleration. While the bundled 805 GB SSD and substantial memory pool offer high cost efficiency for memory-resident databases and large analytical caches, large-scale language model execution demonstrates severe latency limitations without GPU hardware, as seen in poor token processing rates for 70B parameter models. Workloads are best aligned with relational and in-memory databases, real-time analytics, caching tiers, and memory-intensive enterprise enterprise applications requiring fast local scratch storage.
description: Microsoft Azure E20d_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 20 dedicated vCPUs derived from 10 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8370C processor clocked at 2.8 GHz. Designed for memory-intensive workloads, it provides 160 GB of RAM alongside an integrated 805 GB local SSD for high-speed scratch space. Architectural features include AVX-512 vector extensions, cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA-NI, and 48 MB of L3 cache. Benchmarks reflect balanced multi-core execution alongside strong memory throughput, achieving top-quartile PassMark memory results and uncached read bandwidth exceeding 112 GB/s. With an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio and zero bundled GPUs, the instance is cost-efficient for memory-bound systems rather than heavy machine learning training or inference. It is suited for running large relational databases, in-memory caches such as Redis, enterprise transactional applications, and data preprocessing pipelines.
